links.comparator_used: Direct questions to ChatGPT-5.2 without a structured prompt (bundled CRAFT prompt including Context, Role, Action, Format, Tone)
links.outcome: Readability and accuracy of chatbot responses on labor epidural analgesia
links.effect: Direct-question responses ranged from 9th grade to college level; CRAFT responses ranged from 6th to 9th grade. Accuracy 99.8% ± 0.2% vs 99.0% ± 0.4%, P = 0.029. No significant differences in understandability or actionability.
links.quote: Responses generated using CRAFT-based prompt had significantly better readability than those with direct questions only.

links.comparator_used: Direct questions to ChatGPT-5.2 without a structured prompt (Role was one element of the bundled CRAFT prompt)
links.outcome: Readability and accuracy of chatbot responses on labor epidural analgesia (effect of the whole CRAFT bundle, not role alone)
links.effect: Direct-question responses ranged from 9th grade to college level; CRAFT responses ranged from 6th to 9th grade. Accuracy 99.8% ± 0.2% vs 99.0% ± 0.4%, P = 0.029. No significant differences in understandability or actionability.
links.quote: Accuracy was significantly higher in CRAFT-based prompt group than direct-question group (99.8% ± 0.2% vs. 99.0% ± 0.4%, P = 0.029).
